title: Agent persona
description: A HalalChain participant persona in agents/. The `cannot` list is the part that gets enforced: a capability named in `never_grantable` in participants/capabilities/registry.yaml is rejected at load time regardless of which persona declares it.

participant_type.description: An agent is always ai-agent. The distinction matters because the certification machine's ai-never-authoritative invariant keys on it.

tenant_scoped.description: True for every agent. An agent without a tenant has no evidence scope and no place in the isolation model.

can.description: Declared, not inferred. Enforced by participants/capabilities/registry.yaml.

cannot.description: Explicit refusals. An agent with an empty `cannot` list is a persona that has not been reviewed yet, and the schema requires at least one.

skills.description: Skill directories under skills/published/. A reference to skills/staging/ is a load-time failure: staging is inert by design.

escalation.description: What the agent does when it cannot proceed. Every persona needs one; an agent that guesses instead of escalating is worse than one that stops.

then.description: Every ai-agent is tenant-scoped. An unscoped agent is not loadable.
